name: TestDiscovery
summary: Finds the tests without being told where they are, so that writing a test is enough to have it run.

roles.name: TestDiscovery
roles.summary: The participant that builds the suite by looking rather than by being given a list. Its assertion is the one that matters most in practice: a test that exists is a test that runs, so a discovery rule with a gap in it produces a green build for a test nobody has executed in months.
